cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario launch-failure --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs matches Scenario::LaunchFailure and opens the cockpit with LaunchPlan::FailNetwork, workspace Some(1), role the-architect, agent Claude Code, and account Some("acct-claude-work"). FailNetwork in src/bin/jackin/sim/launch.rs completes Stage::Network as Failed. The summary is "The Construct network could not be attached". open_failure in src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs titles a Network failure "Launch failed". Esc dismisses that InfoDialog. The failure layer result is Go::LaunchFailedAck in src/bin/jackin/app.rs, which shows the manager, selects the new instance, and sets "Launch failed · 2 instances still running in the Construct" because populated still has two running instances. The selected record is jk-b5df, failed setup, and "nothing to attach to". Claude Code v2.1.14 is absent. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.return_path: Esc closes the Launch failed dialog and LaunchFailedAck returns to the manager; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: launch-running uses LaunchPlan::Clean from start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs. Ready in src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs sets "Hardline open · handing off to the Capsule" and sends Go::Attach. Motion::Reduced calls finish_handoff in src/bin/jackin/app.rs in that same turn, so the activity is not painted. The visible handoff is the capsule: Claude Code (Work) and Claude Code v2.1.14, and the FailNetwork summary is absent. launch-failure uses LaunchPlan::FailNetwork. The checkpoints are the open "Launch failed" dialog, at 120×40 and then at 80×24 after resize(80, 24), before resize(120, 40) and before Esc. The dialog shows Stage Network, "The Construct network could not be attached", "network jackin-net not found", and "capsule: not started". "Resolving credentials…" is absent. The detail line "credentials: material was resolved in memory and discarded" from src/bin/jackin/sim/launch.rs is below the fold of that open dialog. After Network fails, StepRail::frontier in src/widgets/steps.rs is the next non-terminal step, so the header reads Sidecar while the dialog's stage is Network. Esc then shows one new FailedSetup record, jk-b5df, and not the capsule. hard-cases does not open a cockpit, and cockpit keys x, i, and Esc do not select a plan. open_launch_picker in src/bin/jackin/screens/manager.rs hardcodes Current directory to role the-architect. Down from Claude Code to Codex picks acct-codex-primary. on_layer_result selects LaunchPlan::CredentialsLocked because HardCases has OpSession::Locked and the account id contains codex-primary. The hold dialog from the CredentialError arm in src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs is titled "Credential source unavailable", with "1Password locked: unlock the app and retry" and "paused at the Credentials stage". "Credential check failed" is only the open_failure title when the failed stage is Credentials, which this plan does not use. The activity line still says "Resolving credentials…" while that hold is open. Esc is cancel_index 2 and returns to the manager with one failed-setup record and 3 instances still running. Down Down from Current directory selects infra-control-plane, whose default role is sre in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs. Enter on Claude Code picks acct-claude-personal, which does not contain work, grok, or codex-primary, so the plan is LaunchPlan::BlockedSidecar. The rail shows all 11 stage labels, 05 Agent Binaries skipped, and 09 Sidecar blocked. The activity is "Blocked · this stage cannot continue". Esc stays on that stage and sets "This stage is blocked · x cancels the launch, Ctrl+Q quits". x does not open cancel: ask_cancel returns when LaunchRun::is_terminal is true, and blocked_at makes is_terminal true in src/bin/jackin/sim/launch.rs. Ctrl+C is the control that acknowledges the blocked launch back to the manager.
cases.action_sequence: Launch launch-running and wait for the capsule. Launch launch-failure, shoot the open Launch failed dialog at 120×40, resize to 80×24, shoot it, resize back, then Esc to the manager. Launch hard-cases, open Launch · choose Agent on Current directory, Down to Codex, and Esc from the credential dialog. Launch hard-cases again, Down Down to infra-control-plane, Enter on Claude Code, Esc on the blocked sidecar, then Ctrl+C back to the manager.
cases.expected_results: Clean reaches the capsule and does not paint the hardline activity. FailNetwork shows Stage Network in the open dialog at both sizes, then one failed-setup record and not the capsule. CredentialsLocked pauses at Credentials with Credential source unavailable. BlockedSidecar shows all 11 stages with Sidecar blocked, and Esc does not leave that stage.
cases.forbidden_effects: The failure checkpoints still show Resolving credentials…. The clean launch is judged by the Launch failed dialog. The failure journey treats Claude Code v2.1.14 as its identity.
